value: Silver Waves Resort & Spa
Largest Ocean Front Resort in Daman

Welcome to Silver Waves Resort & Spa, a premier destination for comfort and style in Daman. The hotel offers a blend of elegance and convenience, featuring 85 modern rooms and suites designed to provide a restful and enjoyable stay. Ideally situated in Daman with a sprawling oceanfront view, it offers easy access to the city's attractions, business centers, and entertainment venues.

Check-in time is 2:00 PM. Check-out time is 11:00 AM.

Surat International Airport (STV) is approximately 120 km away.
Vapi Railway Station is approximately 12 km (25 minutes drive) from the resort.
Devka Beach (0.5 km), Jampore Beach (8 km), Nani Daman Fort (3 km), Moti Daman Fort (4 km), Mirasol Lake Garden (5 km).

Deluxe Rooms offer the perfect blend of style and functionality. Features modern amenities, including high-speed Wi-Fi, flat-screen smart TVs, plush king-size bedding, and a writing desk. Approx 280 sq.ft.
Super Deluxe Rooms provide extra space and upgraded interiors, featuring a cozy seating area, premium bath amenities, and partial garden views.
Premium Rooms offer a blend of modern aesthetics and practical convenience, featuring high-speed internet, in-room entertainment, spacious bathrooms with a rain shower, and 24-hour concierge service.
Superior Ocean View rooms serve as a tranquil retreat equipped with contemporary décor, premium bedding, and a private balcony offering breathtaking uninterrupted views of the Arabian Sea.
The Duplex is a home away from home. Thoughtfully designed across two levels with top-tier amenities, an en-suite bathroom, a well-lit desk area, and plenty of space for family vacations.
A sanctuary of peace and comfort across two floors. Equipped with the latest technology, plush furnishings, elegant interiors, and stunning oceanfront panoramas.
Experience the warmth of true luxury hospitality. The Ocean View Suites feature a separate living room, a luxurious marble bathroom with a bathtub, VIP amenities, and a massive private terrace.
Large outdoor Swimming Pool with an integrated Pool Bar. Full-service Wellness Spa offering various massages and wellness therapies.
State-of-the-art Gym equipped with cardio machines and free weights, open from 6:00 AM to 9:00 PM.
Minecraft Kids Den with arcade games, PlayStation, and supervised activities. Book Ladder Library for quiet reading.
Coral Banquet Hall (capacity up to 500 guests) for weddings and corporate events. Sapphire Board Room for executive meetings.
Free on-site secure parking with complimentary Valet Car Parking service during day time.
Cocobay Cafe & Bar: Our signature All Day Dining restaurant serving multi-cuisine buffets (Indian, Continental, Asian) and a la carte menus.
Dagi's Air Deck Lounge: Rooftop lounge offering signature cocktails, premium spirits, and sunset views over the ocean.
Unplugged Live Music performed daily in the evening at the central courtyard/restaurant.
24-hour In-Room Dining is available offering a comprehensive menu of snacks, meals, and beverages.
24-hour Front Desk, Concierge Service, Daily Housekeeping, Laundry & Dry Cleaning (same day service available), Tour Desk.
Free cancellation up to 48 hours before check-in. Cancellations within 48 hours or no-shows will be charged for the first night.
Children up to 5 years stay free when using existing bedding. Extra bed requirement for children above 6 years or adults is charged at INR 1500 per night.
Pets are strictly not allowed on the hotel premises.
All interior rooms and corridors are 100% non-smoking. Designated smoking areas are available outside the lobby and on room balconies.
All guests must present a valid government-issued photo ID (Aadhar Card, Passport, or Driving License) upon check-in. PAN cards are not accepted.
Q: Is breakfast included in the room rate? A: Yes, complimentary buffet breakfast is included for all guests, served daily at Cocobay Cafe from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM.
Q: Do you offer free Wi-Fi? A: Yes, high-speed complimentary Wi-Fi is available in all rooms and public areas.
Q: Is the hotel on the beach? A: Yes, Silver Waves Resort is an oceanfront property located directly opposite Devka Beach.
Q: Can I check in early or check out late? A: Early check-in and late check-out are subject to room availability and may incur an additional fee. Please contact the front desk in advance.
Q: Do I need to bring my own swimming costume? A: Proper Nylon/Lycra swimwear is mandatory for using the swimming pool. Swimwear can be purchased at our resort shop.
Q: Do you provide airport or railway station transfers? A: Yes, we provide paid transfer services. Please book at least 24 hours in advance through our concierge.
